verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Unless a grain of wheat shall fall
Upon the ground and die

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
It remains but a single grain
With no life

verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
If we have died with Him,
then we shall live with Him

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
If we hold firm,
we shall reign with Him

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
If anyone serves me,
then they must follow me

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Wherever I am,
my servants will be

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Make your home in Me,
as I make Mine in you

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Those who remain in Me
Bear much fruit

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
If you remain in me
and My word lives in you

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines: then you will be My disciples

verse.name: v5a
verse.lines:
Those who love Me
Are loved by my father

verse.name: v5b
verse.lines: We shall be with them and dwell in them
